title: Repeated execution of a register program
statement: Let $P$ be a register program, let an oracle assign a Boolean answer to each decider and finite Boolean word, let $c$ be a configuration on input $x$, and let $n\in\mathbb{N}$. Define the configuration after $n$ steps to be the result of applying the program's one-step transition $n$ times to $c$.
hypotheses_covered: A register program with $m$ work tapes, $d$ deciders, and state type $\Lambda$
